title: FlightSeatmap
description: Look up airline seat maps, find the best seats, and manage seat alerts from your AI assistant.
summary: Look up airline seat maps, find the best seats, and manage seat alerts from your AI assistant.
offersHint: Look up airline seat maps, find the best seats, and manage seat alerts from your AI assistant. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.flightseatmap.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_seatmap
toolsPreview.description: Get the seat map for a flight from our database. Shows all seats, cabin classes, characteristics, and availability as both text and an interactive visual seatmap. Returns cached data — for fresh/updated data, use search_flight (sign in via OAuth).

toolsPreview.name: find_best_seats
toolsPreview.description: Find the best available seats on a flight matching user preferences like window, aisle, extra legroom, exit row, quiet zone, etc. Returns a ranked list and an interactive seatmap with recommended seats highlighted.

toolsPreview.name: get_seat_info
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed information about a specific seat on a flight, including characteristics, cabin class, availability, and pricing. Also renders the interactive seatmap.

toolsPreview.name: search_flight
toolsPreview.description: Search for a flight and get fresh seatmap data. Requires a signed-in account — connect this server to sign in via OAuth. Paid plan users can fetch new flights not yet in our database. Uses a search credit. Returns an interactive seatmap with the results.

toolsPreview.name: interactive_seat_finder
toolsPreview.description: Seat finder that recommends the best seats on a flight and renders an interactive seatmap. Good default when the user wants help finding a seat but hasn't specified preferences.

toolsPreview.name: get_seat_reviews
toolsPreview.description: Get user-submitted reviews for a flight, optionally filtered to a specific seat. Shows ratings, comments, seat number, cabin, and helpfulness votes. Free — no auth required.

toolsPreview.name: list_seat_alerts
toolsPreview.description: List all your seat alerts (active and inactive). Shows which seats you're being notified about, priority, days until flight, and last check time. Requires authentication.

toolsPreview.name: create_seat_alert
toolsPreview.description: Create a seat alert that notifies you by email when a matching seat becomes available on a specific flight. Supports preferences like window, aisle, exit row, specific seat, adjacent seats, and class availability. Requires authentication. The flight must already be in our database — use search_flight first if not.

toolsPreview.name: delete_seat_alert
toolsPreview.description: Delete a seat alert by its ID. Use list_seat_alerts to find the alert ID. Requires authentication.

toolsPreview.name: discover_more_flight_tools
toolsPreview.description: Discover other flight & travel MCP servers you can add to your client. Lists complementary remote MCPs covering award flights, airport delays/wait times, and lounges.
